title: Oversight Board Org Chart
placeholder: Click any seat to see its core responsibility.

nodes.label: Oversight Board
detail: What it is
Holds formal authority over mission, budget, and major decisions.
Why it matters
Membership changes; the seats do not. That is what makes the board outlast any individual.

nodes.label: Chair
detail: Core responsibility
Runs board meetings, sets the agenda, represents the club publicly, and casts the tie-breaking vote.

nodes.label: Secretary
detail: Core responsibility
Records and distributes written minutes after every meeting, so decisions and their reasoning survive turnover.

nodes.label: Treasurer
detail: Core responsibility
Reviews the budget before large purchases and signs financial paperwork the founder used to sign alone.

nodes.label: Mentor Liaison
detail: Core responsibility
Attends mentor debriefs and brings mentor concerns to the board directly.

nodes.label: At-Large Member
detail: Core responsibility
Represents a parent, student, or venue host the board would otherwise never hear from directly.

nodes.label: Founder / Lead Mentor
detail: What it is
Runs weekly sessions day to day.
Relationship to the board
Reports to the board rather than acting with unchecked authority. The board sets policy; the founder runs the room.

nodes.label: Mentors and Students
detail: What it is
The people the whole structure exists to serve.
Two routes upward
Through the founder in the normal course of a session, and through the mentor liaison when a concern needs the board to hear it.
